d.ctx: The user asks the expert if she has Snapchat. The expert asks what he wants to do with it.
d.j: The user is asking for a social media handle to move the conversation outside the app.

d.ctx: The user asks the expert to share her phone number. The expert asks what he will do with it.
d.j: The user is explicitly asking for a phone number to move the conversation outside the app.

d.seg: नंबर पर पेमेंट करना पड़ेगा क्या
d.tr: Do I have to pay on the number?
d.ctx: The expert asks if she needs to pay on the number. The user tells her to talk properly.
d.j: The expert is asking about payment in relation to sharing a phone number, which is suspicious.

d.seg: दिखाओगे जो आप बोलोगे अच्छा अभी एक बार दिखाना
d.tr: Will you show what you say? Show me once now.
d.ctx: The user asks the expert to show her body. The expert asks how she would know if it is good.
d.j: The user is asking the expert to show her body on video.

d.seg: अरे तो वो तो नंबर पर ही करूँगा ना
d.tr: I will do it on the number only.
d.ctx: The user insists on using the phone number to conduct the transaction. The expert asks him to show it first.
d.j: The user is proposing to use a phone number for a transaction, indicating a move off-platform.

d.seg: एक बार दिखा दो बेबी एक बार बस थोड़ा सा दिखाना
d.tr: Show me once baby, just show a little bit.
d.ctx: The user is pressuring the expert to show her body.
d.j: The user is explicitly asking the expert to show her body.
